title: Android TextView: compound drawable selector
purpose: Check that an Android XML state-list compound drawable responds to pressed, selected, disabled and RTL states without moving the text.
changes: Added compound drawable state selectors containing solid shapes or @null for TextView and CheckedTextView.
steps: Find Android XML compound drawable selector below the two switches. The first row has a blue oval and the disabled row has a gray oval.
Press and hold the first row. Its oval disappears while pressed and returns on release; the text stays in place.
Turn on Selected text. The first row's oval changes to an amber rounded rectangle. Hold and release the row again; it should disappear during the hold and return amber.
Turn on Right-to-left layout. Both shapes should move to the other side. The disabled row remains gray. Choose OK if these steps work, or Reject with the failing step and your device.
expected: The selector chooses the appropriate shape or no drawable for each state, preserves text spacing, and follows the layout direction.
limits: Selector entries support local or inline solid shapes and @null; non-null shapes must have equal dimensions. Other drawable types, animated transitions, dynamic intrinsic sizes and Android pixel parity remain open.

references.scope: TextView compound drawable state and placement.

validation: 148 Android XML importer tests passed, including selector state and invalid state handling.
Rust rendering test covers pressed @null, checked, disabled and RTL states.
